o: Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found.

v.n: Netflix x CDPR x Cyberpunk Special Announcement
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 - Something Real Sneak Peek

eps.t: Last Chance for a Slow Dance
eps.o: A former edgerunner slipping into cyberpsychosis and a lonely survivor with a fractured past start their stories at opposite ends of Night City.
A desperate call drags Weak back into danger to save a rebellious teen. As D bonds with a young cinephile, painful flashbacks fuel his thirst for revenge.
Weak tries to rescue Talia from a dangerous surgery, but the confrontation ends in disaster. D and Roman discover a chaotic chip that sparks mayhem.

eps.t: Someone That I Used to Know
eps.o: Armed with abilities he doesn't fully understand, D uses Capri's power to infiltrate an Arasaka research facility. Talia and Weak find common ground.
An impulsive act sends Talia into a terrifying spiral. D's obsession with revenge reaches an unsettling new level of violence.
D becomes an anti-corporate vigilante and asks Roman to film his every move. Weak looks into rumors of tech that can transfer digitized consciousness.
Talia's condition takes a startling turn under Capri's watch. D reconnects with an old friend. Weak and Avida chase a miracle cure.
A riot ignites on the streets as D digs deeper into Project Capricorn's dark past. With time running out, Avida and Weak fight for Talia's future.
Omi and D go off the grid, and Kiril takes Talia into custody. Kyoko pushes Project Capricorn forward with frightening results.
A chilling transformation turns the city into a war zone, erupting in an explosive confrontation.
